newsitem.title: USA: Kmart June same-store sales rise 5.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Kmart June same-store sales rise 5.3 pct.

text.p: Kmart Corp said Wednesday same store sales for the five week period ended July 2 rose 5.3 percent.

Total Kmart sales were $3.14 billion, an increase of 3.5 percent from $3.04 billion. Consolidated results include U.S. and international operations, but exclude sales of the discontinued Builders Square operations.

Sales from consolidated operations for the 22 weeks ended July 2, 1997 were $12.89 billion, up 3.6 percent from $12.44 billion for the first 22 weeks of 1996. Same-store sales for the period rose five percent.
"Kmart's sales for the month were on plan and we are pleased with our progress in a number of key businesses," said Floyd Hall, chairman, president, and chief executive officer, in a statement.

Hall said sales of seasonal goods such as outdoor furniture and some home appliances improved. Sales of women's apparel improved slightly in June, but clearance markdowns continue to be higher than plan.
